reply_text:
*I’d hold the merge.* Reviewed `upload-extensions` (`a34d0a4`) against `main` (`2ec441d`). Three correctness findings:

1. *Wrong extension for multi-dot filenames* — `src/extension.js:2`
   `split('.')[1]` takes the second segment, not the last. `report.v2.pdf` gets `application/octet-stream`, and `photo.jpg.exe` incorrectly gets `image/jpeg`. Use the text after the last dot; return `''` when there’s no dot (currently returns `undefined`).

2. *Uppercase extensions aren’t normalized* — `src/extension.js:2`
   `photo.JPG` gets `application/octet-stream` instead of `image/jpeg`, contrary to the README’s explicit contract. Lowercase the extracted extension before lookup.

3. *Inherited object properties bypass the MIME fallback* — `src/content-type.js:11`
   `TYPES` is a normal object, so `contentType('x.constructor')` returns the `Object` function and `contentType('x.__proto__')` returns an object—not MIME strings. Restrict lookup to own properties, or use a null-prototype dictionary/`Map`.

All three existing tests pass; the cases above were reproduced separately and aren’t covered by the suite. No files changed.
